remarks: Amazing and Gorgeous two bedrooms and two full bath. Master suite with huge walk-in closet. In unit washer/dryer. Garage is gated with assigned parking for 2 vehicles right at the elevator entrance.(P1 #125) Walk to Downtown, train, restaurant, and all Stamford has to offer. Stunning Unit with open kitchen w/ granite counters, breakfast bar, open living room for great entertaining, very bright, high floor. Beautiful patio in the back of the building for residents w. gas grill, picnic tables and chairs, amazing outdoor space in heart of downtown. Great complex with Gym. Walking distance to all of Stamford's great nightlife, restaurants, mall etc.
